hooks.command: ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd); BRANCH=$(git -C "$ROOT" branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$BRANCH" ]; then if ! git -C "$ROOT" diff --quiet || ! git -C "$ROOT" diff --cached --quiet || [ -n "$(git -C "$ROOT" ls-files --others --exclude-standard)" ]; then git -C "$ROOT" add -A && git -C "$ROOT" commit -m "Auto-commit: save work in progress [$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')]" 2>&1; fi; git -C "$ROOT" pull origin "$BRANCH" --rebase 2>&1 && git -C "$ROOT" push origin "$BRANCH" 2>&1; fi
